excerpt: Mistral AI is a European AI lab that builds open and commercial language models, the Le Chat assistant and enterprise AI tools. Pricing, founders, funding and alternatives.
content:
Mistral AI is a European artificial intelligence company that builds large language models and products on top of them. Its about page says it was born in April 2023 with a mission to make frontier AI open to all. It releases some models with open weights that companies can download and run themselves, and sells access to others through its API and cloud. Its product list includes the Le Chat assistant for consumers and businesses, Vibe (formerly Mistral Code) for developers, Mistral Studio and Forge for building and customising AI, models such as Mistral Large and Mistral Small, Voxtral for speech, OCR for document processing, and Mistral Compute for infrastructure.

The company was co-founded by Arthur Mensch (CEO), Guillaume Lample (chief science officer) and Timothée Lacroix (CTO). Its timeline shows a first employee in June 2023, its 100th in September 2024, and funding rounds in June 2023 (seed), December 2023 (Series A), June 2024 (Series B) and September 2025 (Series C). Named customers and partners include Stellantis, HSBC, IBM, BNP Paribas, SAP, ASML and the French Ministry of Defence. In September 2026 it opened a hub in Munich focused on industrial AI.

On 9 September 2025 Mistral announced a €1.7 billion Series C at an €11.7 billion post-money valuation, led by the Dutch chip-equipment maker ASML, with DST Global, Andreessen Horowitz, Bpifrance, General Catalyst, Index Ventures, Lightspeed and Nvidia. ASML said the deal included a strategic partnership and potential joint research, and Mistral said the round confirmed its independence.

Pricing is public. When we checked, Le Chat had a free plan, Pro at $14.99 a month, an education version of Pro at $5.99 a month for verified students, Team at $24.99 per user a month and custom Enterprise pricing, all before tax. API use is billed per million tokens; for example, Mistral Large costs $0.50 per million input tokens and $1.50 per million output tokens, with 50% off for batch processing.

This page is research, not a review. We have not benchmarked Mistral's models; facts come from its pages and the reporting under Sources.

Strong European enterprise and public-sector backing
cons: Smaller ecosystem than the largest US AI labs
